item_catalog.image_prompt: Top-down pixel art, textured teal mesh, ivory frame, saffron adhesive.

item_catalog.name: Manual Purge Crank
item_catalog.description: A simple ivory ceramic tool for manually opening jammed pressure valves.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Top-down pixel art, ivory ceramic handle, saffron grip, teal mechanical parts.

item_catalog.name: Emergency Breath Pouch
item_catalog.description: A single-use teal membrane pouch containing five minutes of emergency air.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Top-down pixel art, small teal pouch, saffron pull-tab, ivory nozzle.

item_catalog.name: Signal Repeater Node
item_catalog.description: A saffron-threaded hub that boosts access signals across the lung's vast architectural spans.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Top-down pixel art, saffron coil, ivory ceramic base, teal indicator lights.

item_catalog.name: Pressure-Sensitive Lock
item_catalog.description: A ceramic seal that only opens when the surrounding air pressure matches a specific future.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Top-down pixel art, ivory ceramic lock, teal pressure gauge, saffron dial.

item_catalog.name: Synthetic Cilia Filter
item_catalog.description: A teal membrane graft that filters industrial toxins from the station's recycled air.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Top-down pixel art, teal organic filter, ivory housing, saffron fibers.
